fields.description: Every new Lead with a phone number gets the invitation automatically once the template is approved. Leads added by Data Import are not invited; use Invite on WhatsApp in the Lead list for them.
fields.label: Invite New Leads Automatically
Twilio
fields.options: Messages are sent from the number, Account SID and Auth Token in Twilio WhatsApp Settings. Use the WhatsApp buttons above to create the invitation template and connect restaurant replies.

fields.description: Approved Twilio Content Template SID (starts with HX) of the invitation, filled in by Create Invitation Template.
fields.label: Invitation Content SID

fields.default:
Hi {{ lead_name }},

Would you like to list your restaurant on Buy In Minutes? Please confirm below.
fields.label: Invitation Message
fields.description: The first message, sent as a WhatsApp template with the two buttons below. Placeholders: {{ lead_name }}, {{ first_name }}, {{ company_name }}. WhatsApp rejects a template that starts or ends with a placeholder. Changing it needs a new template.

fields.default: Add Restaurant
fields.description: Up to 20 characters.
fields.label: Confirm Button

fields.default: No, Thanks
fields.description: Up to 20 characters.
fields.label: Decline Button
Join Link
fields.description: Restaurants that open the join link and send the Join Keyword start onboarding themselves. They wrote first, so no invitation template is sent and every reply is a free in-chat message. Use the WhatsApp > Get Join Link button for the link to put on your website, a QR code or a flyer.

fields.default: Join Buy In Minutes
fields.label: Join Keyword
fields.description: Typed in for the restaurant by the join link. Matched ignoring case and punctuation.

fields.default: Welcome to Buy In Minutes! What is the name of your restaurant?
fields.label: Welcome Message
fields.description: The first reply when the number is not a Lead with a name. When it is, Ask Name is sent instead.

fields.default: *{{ restaurant_name }}* is already registered on Buy In Minutes. Our team will contact you soon.
fields.label: Already Joined Message
fields.description: Sent when a number that has completed onboarding sends the Join Keyword again.

fields.label: Onboarding Questions
fields.description: Sent as normal WhatsApp messages once the restaurant has replied, so they can be changed at any time. Placeholder: {{ restaurant_name }}.

fields.default: Great! Is *{{ restaurant_name }}* the name of your restaurant? Reply *YES* to confirm, or send the correct name.
fields.label: Confirm Name

fields.default: Great! What is the name of your restaurant?
fields.label: Ask Name (Lead has no name)

fields.default: Thank you! Please send your restaurant's logo as an image.
fields.label: Ask Logo

fields.default: Got it! Now please share your restaurant's location: tap 📎 → *Location* and send the location of your restaurant.
fields.label: Ask Location

fields.default: Thank you! *{{ restaurant_name }}* has been added to Buy In Minutes. Our team will contact you to set up your menu.
fields.label: Completed

fields.default: No problem, thank you for your time. You are welcome to contact us anytime if you change your mind.
fields.label: Declined

fields.default: Please tap *{{ confirm_button_text }}* or *{{ decline_button_text }}*.
fields.label: Not Yes or No

fields.default: Please send your logo as an image (JPG or PNG).
fields.label: Not an Image

fields.default: Please share the location with 📎 → *Location*, so customers can find your restaurant.
fields.label: Not a Location
Items
fields.description: After the location, the restaurant gets the Items Message with a Select Items button. It opens a list with a tick box per item and Submit, and the chosen items are repeated in the chat. If the form can't be sent, a numbered list is sent in the chat instead. Leave the Item Group empty to skip this step.

fields.default: Snacks
fields.label: Item Group
fields.description: Enabled sales items of this group are listed, up to 20 (a WhatsApp limit).

fields.default:
Which of these items would you like to sell at your restaurant?

Select all that apply below.
fields.label: Items Message
fields.description: Sent with the Select Items button. No placeholders. Changing it, or the texts below, needs a new template (Create Items Template).

fields.default: Select Items
fields.label: Select Items Button
fields.description: Up to 20 characters.

fields.default: Select Items
fields.label: Form Title
fields.description: Shown at the top of the list. Up to 30 characters.

fields.default: Submit
fields.label: Submit Button
fields.description: Up to 30 characters.

fields.label: Items Content SID
fields.description: The approved form that is sent. Filled by Create Items Template once WhatsApp approves it (Check Items Template Status).

fields.label: Pending Items Content SID
fields.description: A new form waiting for WhatsApp approval. The one above keeps being sent until then.

fields.default: Please tick at least one item and tap *Submit*.
fields.label: No Items Selected
fields.description: Sent when nothing was ticked and the form can't be sent again, together with the numbered list.

fields.default:
You selected:
{{ items }}
fields.label: Items Selected Message
fields.description: Sent after the form, before the Completed message, so the restaurant sees what it chose. {{ items }} is the list of chosen items. Leave empty to skip it. No template needed.
Supplier Group of the Supplier created when a restaurant completes onboarding.

fields.description: Added to local numbers such as 0501234567.
fields.label: Default Country Code
Google Maps API Key
fields.description: Turns the location pin a restaurant sends into an address, using Google's Geocoding API. The key must allow server requests (no website restriction). Left empty, only the coordinates and any place name WhatsApp sends are saved.
Twilio sends the WhatsApp number's incoming messages here (set by Connect Restaurant Replies).
